answer: The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. What survives to the violet is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The haven holds work receipts rather than names, so the ember of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, reset on any identity-link attempt. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short.
